# Site check: mychata.cz signed in with four test sign-ins, 18 Oct 2026 (T-042)

Run about 13:10–15:35 Czech time from a cloud session with Playwright and the container's Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`). Live commit `d6260db` (T-041 merge), read from `<meta name="build-sha">` on `/auth`. Signed in as Test 1, Test 2, Test 3 and a fourth maintainer sign-in; writes only in the test cottages (`Chata Alfa (test)`), everything else read-only.

## Findings

1. Fixed in T-042: Back from Photos/Manual/Documents/Maintenance opened the overview instead of returning to Settings.
2. Fixed in T-042: an organisation member's booking screen said "Potvrdit rezervaci" / "ihned zapíše" although the stay is held for an admin.
3. Fixed in T-042: empty white strip under "Žádné úkoly v tomto filtru"; a trailing space in a cottage name showed before the colon.
4. Observation: `Second Home` and two more family accounts of the maintainers carry the same name as their only cottage; the rename prompt of T-042 will ask their admins after publish.
